audit_rule: Exploratory only. Final3s: selected pose valid>=90%, xy_speed<0.15>=90%, angular_speed<0.5>=90%, mean_joint_speed<1>=90%, at least3 feet force>8N>=80%. Later posture loss means selected height/tilt invalid for consecutive1s after success; not automatically physical falling. Ground-relative height depends on center terrain ray.
quiet_rule: Final3s 90th percentile xy<0.15m/s, angular<0.5rad/s, mean_joint<1rad/s; >=3 feet above8N for>=80% frames; median tilt<25.84deg and median ground-ray relative height>0.20m. This does not prove feet bear full body weight or exclude body contact. Exploratory flags, not a new success standard.
major_refall_proxy_rule: After first tiered success, tilt>60deg OR ground-ray height<0.15m for at least0.20s; conservative diagnostic proxy, visually confirm. Not every1s failure of relaxed pose/height is a fall.
